text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Damn it, I lost! Everyone's going to start smack-talking me again!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: They're always like, "You're too short to do well in races"… "You're not suited for the turf"… Pisses me off!
choice_data_list: Channel that frustration into fuel for your training!
Channel that frustration into fuel for your training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: They're always like, "You're too short to do well in races"… "You're not suited for the turf"… Pisses me off!
choice_data_list: Channel that frustration into fuel for your training!
Channel that frustration into fuel for your training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, whatever! I don't need your pity!
choice_data_list: It's not pity! I really do believe in you!
It's not pity! I really do believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: How can you be so sure of me when I have nothing to show for it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All you say is that you believe in me whenever I lose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I don't believe you when you say that!
choice_data_list: Then let me tell you why I'm so confident in you!

text_block_list.text: If she doesn't trust me, then I'll just have to explain everything until she does.
Her competitive spirit and relentless determination, not to mention her final sprint, are her strengths. I'm expounding on her acceptance of and devotion to overcoming her weaknesses, when…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Stop! Geez, okay! I get it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win next time just so I don't have to go through this again!
Somehow, Narita Taishin's mood has improved.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm sick and tired of being looked down on all the time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll blow past everyone and take first place!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm just annoyed that I got caught up in your dumb energy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But, ugh… I guess I need you if I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Beef up my training regimen—make it tougher. If you go easy on me, I'll end you.
Although slightly displeased, Narita Taishin feels more determined than ever to win her upcoming race.
